title: Designing signs

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Coordinate text, symbols and languages so a sign can be read as one navigational instruction.
strategic_value: Consistent icon scaling and language arrangement can make Helsinki signage easier to compare across locations.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture compares icons inline with text or in separate boxes, then compares multilingual lines and columns.
practical_value: Scale inline icons to text, use protected areas for separate icons, and choose lines or columns according to text volume.

content_islands.name: Text/icon arrangements
content_islands.spec: Place A–C sign examples under the shared-scaling explanation.

content_islands.name: Language arrangements
content_islands.spec: Follow with A–C multilingual line and column examples.

ingredient.name: Sign information arrangement
ingredient.application: Scale inline icons to text; size separate icons by their protected area. Separate languages into lines, or columns for large text volumes.
ingredient.scope: Signage arrangements shown in this section.

reference_purposes.Application: The diagrams compare integrated/separate icons and multilingual lines/columns.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Separate icons use their protected area; multilingual signs separate languages into lines, with columns permitted for substantial text.
